Junkyard Shaman.title: 清める
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This album is not a display of my mastery of shakuhachi (for there is none), but more of impressions of places and the shape of my spirit at a certain time at a certain place. Sometimes I wanted to talk to the birds, sometimes to imitate and express the movement of a shadow or wind in the grass. It is not "music" in the sense of "music", but certain captured moments in this universe. Recorded at various times and places, including Kazefukeiwa, Hieizan, and a riverside at Osaka.
このアルバムって、自分の尺八のスキルの説明ではない。これはあの一瞬の説明で、行ってた所の感覚とか、自分の精神のあの時の形の説明と思います。
時々鳥に話したかったとか、陰の動くか風の通りに吹きたかったとか。
ほとんど音楽じゃないですが、この宇宙で、この人生の中で起きた一瞬の録音だと思います。
色々な場所で録音されまして、例えば風吹岩、比叡山と大阪の福の川の岸で演奏していました。
これで自分の心を清めたいです。
聴いてくれたら、ありがとうございます。
Junkyard Shaman.credits:
released August 8, 2021
I used traditional 1.8 shakuhachi (bamboo), plastic YUU shakuhachi, and a maple 2.1 flute.

Junkyard Shaman.title: 残心
Junkyard Shaman.about:
I made this album today, in the aftermath of another typhoon that passed by more or less unnoticed. Last night when it was raining hard I ran myself to exhaustion and then ran some more. It was perfect moment in its own cathartic way.
This album is mostly lingerings on the peace I felt last week when me and my friends took a trip to the mountains. I needed the mountains and the rivers more than I had given myself a permission to think of. Those forests made me think of the forests I grew up in, completely different but still exactly the same, singing the same songs here that they taught me as a child 7000 kilometres away. I feel grateful for the pain that drove me into the woods. It gave me something not a single human being can imitate or take away. Nature taught me everything I know.

released September 18, 2021
Jere Kilpinen - guitar, kaossilator, shakuhachi, voice

Junkyard Shaman.title: なごりない
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This release is a work of read poetry with a noise machine I made out of junk. Side A is poems in Japanese, new poems and shorter pieces from my two books 小さい秘密の本 and　残り灰, both released 2022. Side B is poems in Finnish from a still unreleased book of poems. Digital download comes with photos of the new poems, alternative artwork, track with only the poems without the noise machine and also a live recording from reading performance at Environment 0g, 26th of August, 2022.
Albeit a very nisché thing, if somebody wants to put this out as a small tape release, I will provide handmade artwork for it. Contact me through the contact form.
このリリースって色々な朗読の作品ですね。自作のノイズ機械を使って、小さい秘密の本と残り灰から読んでた。新しい詩も入っています、次の本にそれを入れるつもりです。ダウンロードのボーナスコンテンツは写真とか、アルバムアートとか、ライブ朗読の録音とノイズなしで朗読したファイルがあります。日本語で確かに間違えていたり、発音も読むときあちこちにおかしいですけど、それでもこれをリリースをしたかった。今の状況記念みたいにかもしれない。B面でフィンランド語の詩が入ってます。この二つの言語は自分の心の言葉みたいに考えていますので、こういう風にそれを一緒にさせたいました。いつも支えてくれた皆様、本当にありがとうございます。
これからもよろしくお願いします。

Junkyard Shaman.title: 自分の魂を清めますように。
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Recorded on one take in a rainy Saturday afternoon in Osaka, Japan, 17th of December, 2022. Made in order to try to cleanse my soul of all the mud of self-doubt, grief, loneliness...
I found this tuning originally by accident by randomly downtuning my acoustic guitar without thinking, then struck a chord and instantly knew there were no accidents. I have been using it ever since, as it appears to most precisely fit my soul.
大阪の雨の日には一行で作ったアルバムで、自分の魂を悲しみ、さみしさと自己不信感の泥より清めますように。
このチューニングって、初めて偶然にアコースティックギターを無意識でチューニングして、コードを叩いたら、絶対偶然じゃないのを分かりました。そこからこの同じチューニングをよく使います。自分の気に合う感じです。

Junkyard Shaman.title: 円
Junkyard Shaman.about:
２０２３年の3月24日、自分の此花ガランの個展の最終日にはこのライブがありました。日本に移住したの時先前オープンしたばかりの此花ガランを偶然に見つけて、あのスペースで自分の最初の日本のライブをやったので、現代の場所の最終日でもまたライブができて何となく大事なことのように見えた。それで有難いです。
永遠に土師さんにお世話になって、今の活動のすべてがあの偶然に開けたドアから始めたのをハッキリ見えるからね。
CDでこれと前にリリースをした京都の大粒の泪で年末に録音したライブが入ってます。
On 24th of March, 2023 at the end of my solo exhibition at art space Konohana Garan in Osaka, I had this sound performance.
As Konohana Garan was a place I found by some strange just as it had begun, and where I played my first shows in Japan, I was really honored and grateful to play there on the final night of it's current form. I am forever grateful for Haji Kiyoharu and Konohana Garan, as all my current activities spawned from various small accidents and coinsidences, all of which I can directly trace back to that day when I walked in through that door.
as En in Japanese can mean many things, among those are these two kanjis, the other meaning circle, which was quite present in the content of my exhibition, and the other meaning fate or connection, something really unexplainable in any other language than Japanese.
CD version comes with a recording also released earlier, recorded at Kyoto's Ootsubunonamida at the end of last year.

Junkyard Shaman.title: 空がもう消滅されたのに、それを知らないのか
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This is a work of sound poetry that shows the link and process in between visual art, poetry, music and performance quite well. The other day I had a conversation with a friend, which inspired me to do a set of prints.
Experimenting with those prints inspired me to write a poem, which again evolved into further print. I thought of using that as a sort of mental notation for the live show yesterday, record that and put it out. I also recorded the poem and used it during the live performance.
I did record it, but I realized I messed it up. Nevertheless, the poem on the tape, and the final soundloop used in the performance were still there, so I began this work from where yesterday's performance ended up.
Download comes with photos of the prints.
Junkyard Shaman.credits:
released April 8, 2023
Jere Kilpinen - music, prints, poetry, recording and mixing, artwork, well, everything as usual.

trackinfo.title: 空がもう消滅されたのに、それを知らないのか
trackinfo.lyrics: 空がもう消滅されたのに、 それが気が付いてないのか、 すべての世界はもう燃えたのに それが見えないのか。 この錯覚がついに消え去ったら 我がどこへ行くのか。 この夢から覚めたら また新たな夢が来るのか。 永遠の静かな部屋で 人生の残響が響くのか この人生のすべてが消えちゃったら さみしいことじゃないか。。。 いつか 私がもう消えた後で この体からきれいな花が伸びさしてるのか。 空がもう消滅された、 それを知らないのか 空がもう消滅されたのに、 それが感じられないのか 空がもう消えたのに それをわからないのか。

Junkyard Shaman.title: 灰雪の愛
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Work of lo-fi ambient and poetry, various shorter poems in Japanese. In my mind, this kind of sound is always connected deeply to snow, darkness and beautiful light of winter afternoon.
I hope you enjoy it.
As I am doing all my music now without any aid of computers, the volume level might be slightly lower than your average edm bangers, but I believe you are all wise and considerate people who can committ to the music you are listening to enough to turn the volume up a tiny bit, or even better, make your environment more quiet.
Quite often, especially lately, I have been thinking of words by Yamashita Nobuko, an experimental film maker who I played with in few events. She spoke about the contrast between film and modern world, how everybody wants to have huge, bright screens that show you everything in super HD all the time, but her work is dark, small, hard to see.. it won't get any bigger, you need to get closer. You need to make the effort. I loved that, and her works.
You do not need to see all of the world all the time.
Download comes with selected photographs.

Junkyard Shaman.title: 失句集
Junkyard Shaman.about:
これって、昔と将来の詩、無くしたもの、忘れたもの、見つかったもの、失敗したもの、その中で僕の失敗のような人生の一番大切な宝物もある。そうして失句集、シックシュウって呼んでます。この詩はよくライプの時も使いますね、音楽に合わせてやりますけれども、𠮷原幸子の朗読のテープをユーチューブで聞くと、自分の詩もこんな風に保存したくなってきた。
私にはいつも詩人本人の朗読のは何となくすごく大切なものだと思いました。それはこの世の魔法術だね。意識の中に、言葉が新しい世界を作ってるし、その中で誰かほかの人の意識が自分の本音で響くから、素晴らしい体験だと思います。自分はそんなことが出来るかどうかわからないんだけれども、こんな風にも、言葉だけで自分の世界を建てられたかった。
These are poems I have recorded on tape, poems that I use during live performances. Some of them are from my previous books, some of them will be on the next one in the future.
To me, poets and artists reading their own works has always been a magical thing. Words build up a world inside another persons consciousness, a world within which some other persons true voice is resonating and living inside another mind. I do not know whether I can achieve that or not, but I wanted to have this kind of record of the poetry and my consciousness at this stage of my life.
I also want to release this in tape or CD, if someone is interested.

trackinfo.title: 永遠の玄関
trackinfo.about:
この世の中の皆が
一人一人生まれてくる
一人一人死ぬ

この死の廊下の中で

死の光がまぶしい
死の光がくやしい
沈没船の横にボーっとしてる。
僕がこの世から出るべきなら、
この錆びた舟の横に永眠したい。
この一瞬から
永遠の玄関が開く
この一瞬から
永遠の玄関が開く
この光がまぶしい
この光がさみしい
この光がくやしい
この光がなんとなくなつかしい
このとびらがひらく。
この一瞬から
死の廊下へ入る
肉体の中でも

魂が隠れてる
この肉体の形が
この野生な魂を
もうつかまれられない
この光がわびしい
この光がまぶしい
一瞬ずつ
このとびらがひらく

trackinfo.title: さみしい夜
trackinfo.lyrics: この宇宙の響きがゆっくりきえる。 自分の中の宇宙も少しずつ冷えてゆく。 蝉が弾く音の中で、私が生まれた時の叫びがある。 蝉が弾く音の中で、私の最終の息の音もある。 総ての春の中で、秋の寂しさがある。 私の中でも、まだ生まれてこない君のさみしさもあるよ。 それから、我々の寂しさは永遠に響く。 我々が生まれた前から、 この総ての寂しさもう決めてあったよ。 逃げられないので、耐えることしかない。 一緒にこのさみしい夜を乗り越えよう。

trackinfo.title: もし僕は君の夢だったら
trackinfo.lyrics: 冬風には　さみしいハウルが聞こえてくる　 幽霊たちがハウル　 世界が雪に埋められる　 人生は夢に埋められる　 沈んでゆく。　 この人生は誰かの夢しかないのか。　 もし僕は君の夢だったら、 まだまだ起きないのままで 残ってほしいよ 消えるのが怖いから もう少し 雪の中に眠ろう 春が来る日までに 残ってほしい。

trackinfo.title: 夢の樹
trackinfo.lyrics: 目が覚めても 夢がまだあふれてくる 感情がずっと夢のままである 感情が深海のように そこまでに見えないよ ずっと 虹色の霧の中で迷ってるように 覚めたのか 知らない。 森の中で　道が消えたように ずっとぐるぐる回っていく 私の中で 夢の種がある 頭から茎が出てくる 夢の茎が見えない速さで樹になる。 私の涙がその樹の水、 私の望みがその樹の土地。 夢の樹が段々伸びてくる 青空まで伸びてゆく まだまだ 覚めたのか 一旦 我々も人間だった まだ覚えてるのか。 今は夢の跡の 段々消えている残響しかない。
trackinfo.credits: from 失句集, released February 20, 2025

trackinfo.title: 風に散る
trackinfo.lyrics: 我が意識が薄くなるよ。 私の中に、残り物が減る 冬の初雪のように　君の言葉のように、、 心の中で君の言葉がまだ響いてる　。 僕ははだんだんこの風に消せられてる。 自分でも気が付かないはやさで　 風に消せられてる 砂の山のように。 何処か遠くから。。。 もう波の音が聞こえてくる。 それが聞こえないかな。 私たちの時間はずっと 風と波にに消せられてる。 私たちの人生の残り時間が 灰のように 風に散る。 私たち お互い様は 夢のように 薄くなって 段々消えてゆく。 この一生中で会えて嬉しい。 もしまた生まれ変えたら、 その次の人生でも 私を探してくれないか。
trackinfo.credits: from 失句集, released February 20, 2025

Junkyard Shaman.title: 残骸礼拝
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Album consisting of two recordings. 1st one being Live recording from Environment 0g, Osaka, 8th of December 2024, performed with the butoh by Iori Kinki. The second one being live recording from many years ago in Finland, recorded at my studio space sometime between 2015-2018. Second one comes as a bonus track for those who buy the album. Also very limited CD-Rs available.
"”残骨礼拝”, "Wreckage Worship" from Junkyard Shaman, Jere Kilpinen. Cool! Too cool! It's a two-song album, and the first one has the usual "Japanese Ritual" atmosphere, and features saxophone and voice, so you can feel the "movement". The second song is amazing! He just strums the fuzz guitar. And it's a pretty roaring psychedelic sound! ️I wonder if this is his roots? It makes me think so. It seems to be a live recording, but it's also typical of him not to do anything stupid." Kimihide Kusafuka/K2

Junkyard Shaman.title: 운명의 바다
Junkyard Shaman.about:
운명의 바다, 運命の海, The Sea of Fate.
Lately, my life has consisted mostly of two things. Staring at the sea, and accepting my fate as it is. My life is being thrown around by forces larger than my own strength, and there is not much I can do about it, besides drift with it wherever it takes me.
I am grateful to the sea, for it has given me comfort and a sense of beauty, it has taught me things about this universe that I can never be able to express in any language. It is flowing energy, eternal poetry.
I hope you enjoy this.

Junkyard Shaman.about:
Two live recordings from my recent trips to Japan and Korea. First one recorded at Osaka's Environment 0g, with butoh performance by Iori Kinki, the second one recorded at Arcade Seoul, as part of installation by amazing audiovisual collective Human Infrastructure. The recording features only what I was playing, which was only part of the full performance/ installation, but I found it interesting how it works alone, going towards industrial noise and then flowing back into nothingness.
The name was given by my friend, who after Osaka's performance said that it felt like a purifying ocean of suffering, a buddhist word 苦海. Both names read the same, kukai.

Junkyard Shaman.title: こんな夢を見た
Junkyard Shaman.about:
嵐が終わった後
また穏やかな波が来る。
それが静かに
海辺の残骸に謝る
朝の光が
溢れて来る
うみねこのさみしいなきこえとともに
冬の寒い風は骨色の空へ上がっていく
この燃えた魂の灰が指の間から漏れ逃げてる。
木蓮の香りがここまでに届かない
木蓮の香りがここまでに届かない
見えない色のうた
心の中で響いてる
波が残骸に謝ってみる
返事がないから
怒って
残骸を溺らせてる。
木蓮の香りがここまでに届かない
木蓮の香りがここまでに届かない、、、
After the storm
the calm waves return
Quietly
they ask for forgiveness
from the wreckage.
The morning light
overflows.
The cold winter winds rise up to the bone colored skies
with the lonely cries of the seagulls.
The ashes of this burned soul
run through my fingers.
The scent of magnolias doesn't reach this far
The scent of magnolias doesn't reach this far...
A song of invisible color
is still echoing in my heart
The waves beg for forgiveness from the wreckage
and when there is no reply
The waves get angry
and drown them.
The scent of magnolias doesn't reach this far
The scent of magnolias doesn't reach this far...

Junkyard Shaman.title: ある日には
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This was recorded live on workshop about butoh and poetry in Taipei, 7th of February 2026. It consists of poetry of sounds, tape loops, memories, poems, shakuhachi, material sounds of metal and bamboo, various different elements that build up a mental space or a dream within which the butoh dancers were wandering. Maybe rarely to me I decided to include the poems and their translations, as they were in Japanese and Finnish, two languages not commonly spoken by everyone.
Cover photgraphy by Chihao Bai

trackinfo.title: Valon Kuisketta Hämärässä
trackinfo.lyrics: Näin se alkaa valon kuiskeena hämärässä ruosteen huutona maailmassa joka on jo tyhjä. lopun jälkeisenä jatkumisena Rakennetun ruumiin rapistuvana hylkynä. Maailma palaa juurilleen vaiko itsekseen mitä eroa? Sumu peittää vuoret. Aivosähkö katkeaa. Tyynen veden pinnasta aukeaa uusi taivas uusi maailma yhtä tyhjä kuin tämäkin. Aallot lyövät rantakivikkoon kuuletko miten ne vetävät kiviä mukanaan vähän kerrallaan  takaisin mereen. Ja minä istun tässä tuhkan peittämällä rannalla uneksimassa maanjäristyksistä ja tulvista. Myrsky on jo yllä mutta sen melu on yhä jossain kaukana. Ja minä istun tässä tuhkan peittämällä rannalla ruumiiden hylkyjen keskellä kuuntelemassa ruosteen huutoa aaltoja aivosähkön rätinää, valon kuisketta hämärässä. This is how it begins,  as the whispers of light in the twilight The cry of rust in the world that has already gone empty. The continuing after the end, the collapsing wreckage of a built body. The world is burning by itself. Does it matter? the fog covers the mountains. Neural electricity is cut out. From the surface of a clear pond another sky another earth opens up as empty as this one. The waves crash into the shores can you hear how they pull the rocks  little by little back to the sea? And I am sitting here on an ash covered shore dreaming of earthquakes and floods. The storm is already upon us but it's roar is still somewhere far away. And I am sitting here on an ash covered shore among the wreckage of bodies listening to the rust's screams the waves the buzzing of the neural electricity, the whispers of light in the twilight.
trackinfo.credits: from ある日には, released February 8, 2026

trackinfo.title: ある日には
trackinfo.lyrics: ある日には 君の叫びが風に乗って ここまでに届いてきた ある日には 僕の白骨を洗った川が乾いてきた ある日には 蝶々に飲み込まれた風が嵐になってなかったよ ある日には 僕がつくえの上に忘れてちゃった太陽の光が勝手に消えてしまった。 ある日には 夢から目が覚めた時僕ではなくて、 夢の世の僕だった。 ある日には このさみしい宇宙の最果てに記憶が遂に消え去れました。 ある日には 乾いた川の傷の中で 蝶々が夢から目が覚めて、 一瞬でこのさみしい宇宙が消滅していた。 One day Your scream rode into the wind And arrived all the way to here. One day The river that washed my white bones ran dry. One day The wind swallowed by a butterfly Did not become a storm. One day The sunlight that I forgot on my desk Went out by itself. One day When I woke up The one who woke up was not me But the me from within a dream. One day The last memory of this lonely universe was finally forgotten. One day On a dry wound of a river A butterfly woke up from it's dream And in a blink of an eye this lonely universe Disappeared.

Junkyard Shaman.title: 残雲粛々山
Junkyard Shaman.about:
残雲粛々山
ざんうんしゅくしゅくさん
今日はこの小さな禅語か瞑想か詩の様な事を自分に作った。
雲に隠れても、山が粛々とずっとある。見えなくても、天気と季節が変わっても、山が状況に関わらずずっとある。このような心があれば、人生はどうにもなっても、きっと大丈夫だろう。
Lingering Clouds, Solemn Mountains.
A little meditation or zen poem I played today for myself.
Even when hidden by clouds, the mountains remain silent and still. Even when they can not be seen, even with the changing weather and seasons, the mountains remain regardless of circumstances . If one can achieve this kind of mind, they will be alright, no matter what life brings.

Junkyard Shaman.title: 子供は6時食べます
Junkyard Shaman.about:
先日には街に散歩したときこの写真を見つかって、写真で小さなメセージが貼ってありました。「子供は６ジ食べます」と書いてある。誰かはベイビシッターへ説明を書いて、あの方は今道にそれを捨てて、僕は偶然にそれを見つかった。そんな小さな起きることはすごく面白い。そこから頭の中ずっとそれを考えてた。ゆっくり音楽も現れてもらった。その子どもたちの音楽。存在ない子供には作った音楽です。自分の子供時代の感じがさせてしたかった。ムーミンアニメのような音楽だけど、私の心から出たので、いつも最初に思ったより悲しい出てるちゃう、と思います。
The other day, when I took a walk in the city, I found this photo and posted a small message on it. It says, "Children eat at 6." Someone wrote an explanation to the baby sitter, they threw it away, and now I happened to find it. It's very interesting to have such a small thing happen. From there I was thinking about it all the time in my head. The music appeared slowly. The children's music. It's music made for children who don't exist. It made me feel like my childhood. It's music like Moomin anime, but it came out of my heart, so I think it's always sadder than I first thought.

Junkyard Shaman.title: A Bed For A Ghost
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This album started from a joke, but I knew it would work. My intuition about people is pretty strong, and when I first met Jerry it almost made me laugh when, as soon as he opened the door behind me, the voice in the back of my mind said "THIS. PAY ATTENTION.". I knew improvisation would work well, we played once live last year and it did, but maybe because it was too easy it took a longer time to materialize. But it did, and I am glad.
We recorded all of this in about 1 hour, it was relaxed and nice session, and we both mixed and compositioned our own versions of this and released them separately. I really like Jerry's version, so go give it a listen too! Also check out his book Terminalian Drift, which is really good.

Junkyard Shaman.title: All Rivers Run Up Towards Hell
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This album was recorded a year ago, in October 2019, in a rental studio in Osaka, Japan. It was born out of my experiments with playing guitar in the way Japanese biwa is played. I came up with the tuning that would allow me to bend the notes more freely, and would resonate with me emotionally. I originally did not release this due to the recording quality which I thought to be sub par, which might be sort of ironic thought in the head of a musician that has done mostly just lo-fi noises and junk music. But I think the emotional response gets translated, maybe even enhanced due to the recording quality.
In a way, this is my scroll of guitar. Every aspect of my playing is in these works, and if one studies it thoroughly, they understand how my mind works.

Junkyard Shaman.about:
増幅座禅。Amplified zazen.
15th of May, around noon I contact microphoned my body and meditated for half an hour. This is what goes on within my body as I do nothing. Somewhat surprisingly to myself, I found it more musical than I thought it would be.
The night before it was raining in Osaka, so I recorded a certain piece of time as it was on planet earth. A world within, a world without.
Carving the artwork took three or four times longer than recording this album.

Junkyard Shaman.about: This album is continuation for the Flesh Hole (released by Industrial Coast as tape, Freak Animal as a CD, both 2019). Visions from the junkyards, fringes of everyday life, dreams from the future. Every instrument is some crap from my floors. Empty bottles, juice can, chair, a painting, stuff like that.
The vision in this was the sacrificial rite of some post-apocalyptic urban tribe, mankind returning back to their roots, voodoo, collecting all that's left from our society, garbage, using them as instruments.

trackinfo.lyrics: He will guide me up to the sky And I will climb up the ladder And I will climb up to the sky And He will hand me down the ladder And He will let me come up And He will let me join His right side And He will let me climb to the sky
trackinfo.about:
This is my attempt to bring my drawings in to the form of music, lots of different elements combined together in a really ...not-logical way.
The vision was inspired by the name of the Swans album I have never heard, My Father Will Guide Me Up A Rope To The Sky. I think the image of that is just amazingly strong. I think it has it's origins in polynesian mythology, if I remember correctly. But in this one, satan and god, good and evil are the same presence, and climbing up is also climbing down.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Desert Trip
Junkyard Shaman.about:
I had bought myself a worn out old Ford. It wasn’t an actual beauty, but it sure was cheap. As a matter of fact it was the ugliest one in the shop, which in itself was a sheer horror show. Everything was greasy and dirty and they played some shitty music on the radio, you know, the kind of up-tempo songs with minor chords and some sevenths here and there to make everyone feel even more miserable. The owner seemed to have given up on his employees. That slimy car salesman had promised me it would not get me past thousand miles. I took it. I just wanted to drive to the desert, for once not to think about any consequences of my actions, just DO IT! And I did it. I drove on into the night, down the dirt road as fast as I could. I knew not what awaited me at the end of that road, I did not know, nor did it matter, since it was the road I had chosen to drive until the car would run out of gasoline or I would simply collapse. I had no further intentions whatsoever, just to drive, drive, drive into the break of dawn, into the arms of tomorrow, to drive towards my freedom.
I had walked for hours, but the darkness seemed unbreakable, as though it would have been only thickening around me since the beaten up car ran out of gas. I did not mind, though it was cold, it was silent. Lizards and vultures escaped me as I tried to find my way through the darkness. Moon seemed like a huge bowl of moldy soup in the dark sky, but it helped me see as soon as my eyes got used to it’s dim light. The desert seemed to weave a web of tranquility around my nerves, I hoped this night would never come to an end, I was hoping maybe this could be the night I'd depart from my flesh. Although the thought had always terrified me, I thought there would be no better time. Right here, right now. It would be a life complete. It would be a destiny fulfilled.
When the stars started to blend into the twilight of a new dawn, I could not believe I was still amongst the living. I kept walking, for there was pretty much nothing else one could do in the desert without any other mean of transportation than one’s own two good feet. I passed a skeleton of a bovine creature of some sort, seeing death "live" sent chills down my spine and brought back the love for this flesh, these mortal eyes that one day would stare blindly into the break of another dawn, not recognizing it, not understanding the sight, not having a concept for understanding, not to mention concept of mere existence, my hopes of losing my life seemed like a distant dream, something that had happened to someone else instead of me. I felt like a snake, shedding my old skin, crawling out of my old self, and I understood, that this would be a brand new dawn, like no other I had seen in my whole life. I kept walking, until I found a gas station along the road. It would be a lie to say I didn’t feel disappointed at myself, when I found my weakened hand opening the door and walking in, telling the tired clerk to call an ambulance.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Echoing Bones
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Years ago we made a short interview with a Finnish self-proclaimed witch who said something that has echoed in my mind ever since. He said that back during the cold war when people were making nuclear tests when he was a child, he could feel the resonance of the bombs in his bones, he could feel the suffering of earth in his body. For some reason I have been thinking of that image a lot lately.
Probably more after watching Akira Kurosawa's Rhapsody in August, where there's a scene where the classmates of the children who died in the Nagasaki bombing, now old people themselves, go plant flowers on the memorial statue each year. I think that is one of the strongest images in any movie ever. Perseverance and humanity standing in the face of our own horrid destruction, all this suffering we are causing to each other and this earth. Why does it appear to be so fucking hard to be a human and treat each other and this earth with kindness and care?

Junkyard Shaman.title: Exhausted
Junkyard Shaman.about: "She took a deep breath and leaned back in her chair. The gas fumes went straight up to her head and lit her brains with thousands of weird and unexpected connections. She felt lightheaded and fuzzy. Somehow through the curtain of I-don’t-give-a-fuck she managed to understand that she was in a seated position, sitting in an old arm-chair. Slowly the reality around her started to mold itself into a living room. A small coffee table right in front of her, an empty bookshelf to her right. Her wrists were aching for all the masturbation, but she couldn’t really help herself. The butane induced serenity was the only thing keeping her from beginning all over. She didn’t even care. She was far out. And for a brief moment she felt better than in months. Life didn’t seem as unbearable when she was high. Nothing was unbearable when she was high. She played with the thought of exhausting her brain of all oxygen and just slipping through the sweet haze that would carry her off the edge of time and space and into the infinite, calm bliss of death, but somehow it made her feel uneasy. Not yet. Not just yet, she thought to herself as her fingers slid across the vast plains of her smooth skin.."

Junkyard Shaman.title: February Experimental Album Writing Month
Junkyard Shaman.about: Last February I participated the album writing month, the goal of which being to write 14 songs in a month. Whole thing seemed to have a cocky approach to it ("can you do it...?") so I figured I go way beyond it. I came up with at first 14 different experimental ways to record a song, and then came up with few extras too. All in all I wrote 21 songs in February. The name tells it all, whether it be recorded blindfolded or without hearing any backing tracks, played in reverse or having a printer as a drum machine. I had fun, and I'll probably do it again next year.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Flesh Hole
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This is my new spoken word/avantgarde album. In a way this is the album I was supposed to make last summer, but it was not possible until now. This album required the amount of flesh anxiety I now have to be finished. Released by Industrial Coast (tape) and Freak Animal (CD)
It is a piece of work that is separated in side A and B as follows:
A
1. All Gone
2. Screaming Bodies in the Rust
3. Body Anxiety I
4. Burn Bundy Burn!
B
1. Buto
2. Sinking Ship
3. Body Anxiety II
4. Let Me Crawl Through Your Hole
5. Gone Out

Jere Kilpinen - words, thoughts, scrap metal, kantele, guitar, saxophone, springs, body sounds, recording, mixing, illustrations, everything.

Singled out thoughts on magnetic tape loop repeating all over, same and same all over, repetitive junk, boring existence endlessly suffer. Repeat endlessly at arms reach life to take my own life to take just one word and all ruined all gone ruined words repetitive mind alone, endlessly suffer. Blabbering bladder, junk mind, no eyes no mind no thought just repeat loop magnetic thoughts repetitive thoughts all gone endlessly suffer no more thoughts no eyes to see, junk mind junk existence all gone all gone all gone all gone.

trackinfo.title: Screaming Bodies in the Rust
trackinfo.lyrics: We are thrown into this dark cold world blind, kicking and screaming blind bodies tweaking like junkies on withdrawal, just bodies in the mud rib cages apart muscles contracting, holes and orifices throbbing. Somebody screams, everything hurts, We inhabit this dark world, all alone, lost, helpless, we lie on our back, limbs arched towards the sky, covered in mud, staying still like cowards, bleeding sores, mud people, broken fingers, empty cans, bleeding wounds, empty bodies,  dead rats washed ashore, screaming bodies in the rust, screeching trains sail endlessly  on dead tracks, the eerie sound that they make, coward bodies, still, in the mud, what more. Fire burns, scream here another there, dark world lit only by fire, all gray where no rust of the flames. Empty cans, empty bodies, screams silent that all.

trackinfo.title: Sinking Ship
trackinfo.lyrics: I have become something I never wished to be, how could I ever have foreseen any of this? A being of physical existence, neurotic hostility cast in flesh and blood, bones framing the anxiety I carry with me everywhere.  No matter what I tried I always failed miserably. I wish I could play NOTHING, leave room for emptiness, let it fill my music as it has filled my consciousness, but there is always too much noise all this noise that keeps interfering, filling up the bladder and pissing all over it. I hate it. I can only create piss, stupid and meaningless noise, not silent enough, always too loud, full of noise always too this and always too that, never enough no never little enough, just noise, too much noise. I never wanted this. I never expected this. I never longed for any of this. But this is the sinking ship that I am strapped to.

trackinfo.lyrics: Now that I'm already gone,  already gone through the hole,  not through one from which I came,  but from the one through which I go out. Go out through the hole,  hole in the ground,  fill hole with flesh,  fill it with thought,  with no thought and yes flesh,  abandoned corpse, for worms to decompose,  spare parts, scrap joints,  used skin.  Abandoned this flesh, no use anymore,  abandoned this world, no use anymore,  abandoned thought, no use anymore. Gone beyond, who?  Can't remember, the one who thinks: gone,  gone through the hole,  not from which it came in,  but through that from which gone out.  Gone out, gone,  beyond all holes,  all thoughts abandoned,  flesh abandoned,  world abandoned,  I abandoned,  gone out,  out through the whole,  not from which it came in, but from which it gone out, out through the whole,  not from which it came in, but from which it gone out,  out through the whole,  not from which it came in, but from which it gone out,  out through the whole,  not from which it came in, but from which it gone out...

Junkyard Shaman.title: Haihtuma
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Haihtuma, Finnish for Evaporation.
This is something I recorded today, after spending a couple of days thinking of transience of everything, changes, and my life. Many changes appear to happen slowly when you are living your daily life, but when you are cut off of it and then suddenly put back few months later, everything has suddenly changed almost beyond recognition. I knew it was coming, but I did not expect it to happen yet.
What was mine is now evaporating.
What comes after will be for somebody else.
haihtuma、フィンランド語って蒸発っていう意味です。
これは今日録音した瞑想で、この大阪帰った時から色々な変わったことを見て、人生の無常なことを反省したことの作品です。日常に生きてたら、人生は中々変わらなさそうだけど、しばらくに離れると、全部は突然もうわからないぐらいに変わってきたような感じです。これも、いつか起きるのを分かったのに、こんなに早く起きるのを思わなかった。
私があったことはもう蒸発されゆく。
これからのことは誰かほかの人のことだろう。

trackinfo.title: Haihtuma

trackinfo.title: The Reflections Beside Me
trackinfo.lyrics: Train trembles and moans unsteadily as it plunges into the darkening night. Outside the flourishing, green woods pass by, but as the darkness weaves it's web around the world, I am left to stare at my own reflection in the window. It is like some dirty and scratched mirror, that breaks at every station and shows me another bit of the real world and other people, who watch me watch back at them, tired, uninterested. Their world is the world of social interaction, polite questions and even more polite, or in some case clever and witty answers. I could play that game too. I know. I just played it for the last six hours, and it wore me off. My thoughts are drifting and slowly sinking, like some recently dead animal on the surface of a small swampy pond. Probably some careless mammal who got too confident and just a bit too far from the shore. The train plunges into a tunnel like some childish movie-metaphor, and the pressure starts fucking my ears... Another stop. I am far too bored to watch out of the window anymore. I just sit, let my mind fill these empty seats with people who don't exist. There's the local vet, Mr. Hannigan, sitting next to the butcher, Mr. Flay. They're holding hands at smiling at each other. They won't notice us, no matter how we try to break their eyecontact or shout at them. Right in front of me sits the sweetest old couple imaginable. Mr. and Mrs. Thompson. At nights they like to gag and bound eachother and play all kinds of sadistic games that would make any of us younger passangers flinch. I smile at them and they smile back, simultaneously. Like some old, perverted sex-robots. I start staring out again... because I'm fucking bored..
trackinfo.credits: from Houses of Healing, released June 14, 2013

trackinfo.title: The Void Beyond Me
trackinfo.lyrics: And I saw this in my dream I was climbing up a mountain I was not alone. There were many people with me And we came to this huge and flourishing forest It's roof was of pines and it's floor of moss. You could barely see the sepian sunlight sift through the thick branches But everything was quiet And everything was beautiful. But those who were with me were too busy complaining They could not see the beauty of it all They could not see beauty at all. Although they were about to drown in it. One by one they were left behind. I kept ascending. Suddenly I reached the summit. It was completely flat, and there was a river cleaving it right in the middle. The sun was shining, there was no wind, no worries. There was strange sort of symmetry in all this. But even stranger was what I saw in the river. There were white monkeys, playing in the river with small white dogs They were splashing in the water,and the water drops shone in all colors Imaginable to human mind, like diamonds It was pure elation, happiness portrayed in a mental landscape. And I could do nothing but stare, and smile. It was mental acid. I have never been as happy in my conscious life as I was in my unconscious life at that moment watching those white monkeys and those white dogs play. I left this all behind. Turned back. Descending back to the woods. It was almost dark. I tried to convince other people that they should go on climbing What was waiting on top of that hill was worth all troubles But they had already given up. They had decided to give up. And they never saw what I saw And no one never will. It was all a dream. And now it has ceased to be. And it exists only in my memory. And it will tarnish and fade with time. Until it is completely forgotten.  Until it is gone.

trackinfo.lyrics: And I believe it was the eighth day when God built the house To the top of the tree of life It was merely a shackle put together with loose boards and bad carpentry I really can't see where Jesus got his skills, since his old man most certainly didn't have any And there he settled for his old days, To the house of eternal creation He died in his sleep and his children on the earth carried on his work of creating things out of dirt And these children grew up without their dad And the first time they saw a picture of their old man They thought it was a picture of themselves And then things got real bad, real quick Dirt became gunpowder, gunpowder became atoms Atoms came together, had a little wedding down in Hiroshima and we all know how well that went down, don't we now? What used to be voodoo is now replaced with things you do All the cheap tricks I could do But would not if I had a chance to choose Since whatever we ever choose to lose in the end it'll all be just paying dues, to reap the crops of this cruel bloom To prepare ourselves for impending doom To tear down this house our old man build And to replace it with our own For that is the cycle of life and now we watch it turn another time.

The bad seed, that grew too far Tall enough to block the sun Building home out of nature COnjuring life from dead objects Forcing life to mould into a house And we build a house of frustration We build walls from the dreams that went lost, long gone We use insecurity for floors, And lock our fears into the basement. They're sitting there in the corner Terrifying themselves Broken pieces of ourself The roof is built from unrealistic excpetations drifting wood and isolation. We waste hope on the windows Thinking it would keep the cold outside But we all know that's just another lie In denial of our mortal lives we sacrifice some more time To feel alive for one last time. it brings tears to my eyes to actually realize How much more we could have been If we didn't waste time in growing beards to our chin Drinking beers, shouting cheers, approving all atrocitites the thieves happened to come up with One-way route, empty canal, a path less traveled lies ahead But we rather stay inside, enjoy our petty lives And let the thieves enjoy our hospitality For another day.

trackinfo.lyrics: Thieves wave their bony fingers, swaying their slender arms in the winds of change, future misfortune and disappointments. All the hope ills these people, these wretched beings that hide in the safety of their stone halls. These thieves have a grin that pierces your defense and assures you can trust them. And you do, and you open your pockets and you open your houses and you show them the way to your valuables and you let them steal everything. This world is full of rotten thieves, just like these. And they are the ones we chose to lead this world. And they grin, and they grin and you let them in.. And you let them lead and they reward you by cutting you open. And you bleed and you bleed until you're just meat. And it never stops... Bones of yesterday are hung from the ceiling. We remember the skin that used to cover them Wrapped around them so tight it felt like you could push the finger through.. It's all so easy to say that you'll be here tomorrow when you can't stay. Life assumes you take care of yourself,  because no one else will. Unless the people around you will. So you better take care of them too, or they might not give two shits about you.

trackinfo.title: House of Emptiness
trackinfo.lyrics: Sand will cover my bones The dirt may swallow me whole The universe will unwind my soul And all there is left is this song We are always alone We are always alone And we can write songs to comfort our ghosts.. The sand will grind my bones to dust that fills up the hole My veins will dry up like a ditch My blood will run in willows' barks We are always together We are always together We are always alone And we can write songs to comfort our ghosts. My bones will once be sand My skin will split (and part) like the Red Sea The universe will claim back my soul And all there'll be left is this song We are just comforting our ghosts Leaving our homes, digging holes Burying our hopes,  Building empty houses for ghosts Putting up facades just for show.. Empty your mind Only then will you realize The true nature of all life Conscious of itself, Observing itself Crawling back to it's self Escaping itself. Abandon everything you know Abandon all your ghosts Abandon all you think you know about yourself Knowledge is just a crooked picture on the wall You are nothing like that, not at all. We are all one, entangled in this mortal coil Just waiting to be lowered back to the soil Burying loved ones along the way Until one day it's their turn to mourn you. trackinfo.title: Ajatuskone
trackinfo.lyrics: Tietoisuus ei synny yksittäisissä soluissa. Se ei asu neuroneissa, tai neuroniryppäissä. Tietoisuus syntyy kommunikaatiossa solujen keskinäisessä vuorovaikutuksessa ja niiden yhteyksissä. Näillä metalliobjekteilla ei yksinään ole tietoisuutta mutta kun niille antaa kielen ja keinon rakentaa kommunikaatiotaan muistin tapaan vanhan informaation päälle syntyy vähitellen jotakin jota voidaan pitää analogiana älykkyydestä... Eräänlainen simuloitu tietoisuus, joka vähitellen alkaa muodostaa tunteita jotka välittyvät observoijalle. Vähän kerrallaan olen rakentanut mekaanisen keinoälyn, eräänlaisen ajatuskoneen... Keinotekoisen tietoisuuden joka saatuaan älykkyytensä kääntyy havaitsemaan itseään ja synnyttää keinotekoisessa mielessään todellisen  eksistentiaalisen ahdistuksen.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Junkyard of Unseen Dreams
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Another collection of recent live performances in various places and times.
I used self-made junk instruments, tape loops, shakuhachi, guitar, breaking saxophone, various metal objects, my body, stones, what ever is at hand. All the music is just expression of subconsciousness as it runs through me as I play. Build up, flourish, collapse and disintegrate. Repeat ad nauseam

Junkyard Shaman.title: Kaikkeus
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Suomenkielisiä, minimalistisia, mielenvikaisia ja psykedeelisiä lauluja. Käskettiin laittamaan "sieluun sattumis-varoitus" kylkeen. Ilmaisen latauksen mukana tulee bonuksena Mana Manan Kuolla Elävänä coveri.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Kalmio
Junkyard Shaman.about: Avantgardist spoken word "shit". Born out of severe frustration.

trackinfo.title: Kylmiö
trackinfo.lyrics: Uusi jääkausi saapuu kaupunkeihin jäädyttäen kadut ikuisen odotuksen tilaan, kuiviin suoniin ja tyhjiin minigrip-pusseihin.  Kylmä riipii ihojen läpi,  suoraan luihin ja ytimiin vaikka asunnoissa on 37 astetta lämmintä, vaikka valkuaisaineet kiehuvat sihisten ja poksuen lämpötilan ylittäessä kriittisen pisteen,  sielu pysyy roudassa ja tunteet jäässä. Hyönteisen silmien läpi maailma on vaarallinen paikka,  paikka jossa kaikki muut tahtovat murskata sinut, päästä sinusta lopullisesti eroon. Ainut joka sinua rakastaa on lähtenyt pois, eikä tule koskaan enää takaisin. Kylmät kiviseinät imevät hehkulampun vähäisen sähkövalon, hengittävät ulos hometta jota sinä hengität sisään.  Keuhko kurtistuu ja rahisee voimattomana. Voit nähdä jo ihosi lävitse,  nähdä valheesi läpi siihen luuttomaan ytimeen,  joka velloo kaiken lian ja saastan alla.  Kaiken sen pehmeän liman ja kudoksen keskellä pieni, kova kimpale, jota joskus kutsuit sieluksesi, mutta jota et tunnista enää.  Sykkeen ainoa tehtävä on kuljettaa verta aivoihin, jotta voisit tuntea edes pienen plasebon verran kaikuja menneestä onnesta,  kaikista niistä elämäsi ensimmäisistä kerroista jotka vielä tuottivat iloa, mutta se kaikki on nyt takana päin.  Tuli toinen kerta, tuli sadas kerta, hehku himmeni ja sammui, jätti jälkeensä enää janon ja kylmyyden.  Ruumiisi on pelkkä kylmiö jossa säilytät riippuvuuttasi. Tyhjä tila joka humisee ja kaikuu sisältä.  Itseviha ei tee mistään helpompaa, mutta ei se mitään vaikeutakaan. Se vain on ylläsi paksun repaleisen peiton tavoin, jotain lapsuudesta tuttua jota olet saanut kantaa mukanasi läpi kaiken sen paskan, jonka keskellä olet ryöminyt.  Lämpötila on enää 30 astetta. Väsymys on ylitsepääsemätön seinä, etkä voi olla sulkematta silmiäsi, hetkiseksi vain...
trackinfo.credits: from Kalmio, released May 1, 2017

trackinfo.title: Kulmio
trackinfo.lyrics: Kaikki maailman ihmiset istuvat kulmioiden  hypnotisoimina vastaanottamassa viestejä planeetan keskusaivolta suurelta romuhyönteiseltä Kuningattarelta joka injektoi ajatukset päähämme  ärsykkeiden loputtomassa tulvassa, piilotettuna, koodattuna uutisiin viesteihin, sanojen ja kuvien virtoihin Ihmiset näyttävät samalta, puhuvat samalla tavalla jopa haisevat samalta, pelolta kaikki maailman ihmiset levittävät ympärilleen pelon ja ahdistuksen löyhkää kunnes koko maailma tuntuu hukkuvan tuohon löyhkään Rikkaat kättelevät vain toisiaan ja jokainen hymy maksaa miljoonan rahassa ja veressä Korjattu hymy joka vilahtaa jokaisessa mahdollisessa välissä, sinetöiden miljardit kohtalot vankiloihin joisa ketään ei enää hymyilytä. Kulmiot kantavat viestejä vieraista todellisuuksista, työntävät huumeita suoraan aivoon, antamatta mahdollisuutta puolustautua. Hymyilevien ote hymyttömistä on murskaava koura, hikinen ja lihava puristus joka jättää jälkeensä kasan luita, joita kojootit ja korppikotkat kaluavat auringon alla. Raha ei riitä elämiseen, eikä elämä riitä rahan haalimiseen. Sähköinen kulmio syöttää ihanteita, ajatuksia, malleja ja tavoitteita joita kukaan ei voi täyttää.  Vastarinta tukehtuu rajattomaan mahdollisuuteensa ja sen verestä nousee lisää keskinkertaisuutta. Kulmiot syöttävät unelmia voitoista pitääkseen huolen siitä, ettei kukaan koskaan voita mitään....
trackinfo.credits: from Kalmio, released May 1, 2017

trackinfo.title: Kalmio
trackinfo.lyrics: Tänään minä näin ihmiskunnan kurjuuden, sen suonissa kiertävän mädän ulosteen ja myrkkykaasuina taivaalle leviävän uloshengityksen. Ruumiit kulkevat kaduilla vakuutellen itselleen olevansa elossa, peittäen luonnollisen kuolemansa merkit uusilla naamioilla, mädäntyen sisältä omista rakenteistaan kuin homeiset kerrostalot. Toiset väistelevät todellisuutta kaikin mahdollisin keinoin. Ilta illan jälkeen kauppakeskuksissa jonotetuille ilmaisille ämpäreille keksitään uusia käyttötarkoituksia tehokkaammin, kuin mitä lainsäätäjät kerkeävät julistaa laittomaksi. Toiset todellisuus hakkaa joka ilta. Nyrjähtäneitä niveliä, poikki napsahtaneita luita, ruumiit ovat rytmikkäitä soittimia. Veri kohisee aivoissa kuljettaen happea ja hallusinaatioita, hetkellisiä harhoja ilosta ja onnesta, haihtuvia usvaisia pilviä, jotka jättävät jälkeensä näivettyneen olon. Kaikkialla katukuvassa läpinäkyvät romun tykittäjät paistattelevat limaisina alkukevään kylmän auringon paisteessa. Joku ohikulkija astuu yhden päälle, jalka uppoaa lihaan kuin hyytelöön ja jättää jälkeensä opiaatin katkuisen löyhkän.  Askelten tasaisessa kopsahtelevassa rytmissä on yksi kostea tauko, muuten kukaan ei huomaa mitään eroa. Kaikki jatkuu kuten ennenkin. Kurjat ruumiit pitävät omaa rytmikästä meluaan. Ruumiiden rakentamat koneet hurisevat ja kolisevat ja rämisevät asfaltilla. Raha vaihtaa taskua. Ihmisiä syntyy ja kuolee.  Veri kohisee aivoissa kuin ennenkin. Kalmiossa on kaikki ennallaan..
trackinfo.credits: from Kalmio, released May 1, 2017

Junkyard Shaman.title: Katkos
Junkyard Shaman.about: Moving from one thing to another - there is always a disruption in between, sometimes large liminal space, sometimes a blink of an eye during which your consciousness does not even perceive the change. Nevertheless, at some point you realize you have been transcended from your previous consciousness into the next. Sometimes I wonder whether death is like such transition, in a way that I could have died without myself noticing it, continuing to live on but slowly losing parts of myself, disappearing quietly, without a trace, even to myself, without myself even noticing my disappearance at all..
Junkyard Shaman.credits:
released March 16, 2021
Jere Kilpinen - guitars, junk, shakuhachi.

trackinfo.title: Kuolleet Etanat
trackinfo.lyrics: Sade houkuttelee etanat ulos piiloistaan ne pyörivät kadulla laiskoina ja sekopäisinä aivan kuin taivaalta sataisi heroiinia suoraan niiden pieniin suoniin. Ne tuntuvat tähtäävän saappaiden alle, ikään kuin pienet itsemurhapommittajat  hyökkäisivät äkkiä varjoista väkijoukon keskelle räjäyttämään bussilastillisen turisteja. Raajoja ja bussin osia lojuu siellä täällä kuin granaattiomenan kuoria ja siemeniä, verta on jokapuolella ja aurinko kuivattaa sen katukiveykselle..... Täällä puolestaan kadut ovat vain märät ja kiiltävät, etanat jatkavat matkaansa ja väistelen niitä parhaani mukaan. Siitä huolimatta kuulen jatkuvasti niiden rasahtelevan kenkieni pohjiin, yksi kerrallaan. .     .     .     .    . Kuolleet etanat saavat minut aina tajumaan ettei jumalaa ole olemassa. Kuolleiden etanoiden satunnaiset hajanaiset hautapaikat näyttävät, miten satunnaista elämä ja kuolema on, ei ole olemassa mitään kohtaloa, ei mitään kättä joka ohjaisi meitä kohti jotain tiettyä paikkaa tai hautaa, ei ole mitään muuta kuin tämä hetki, ei ole mitään muuta kuin tämä hetki ja se hetki jolloin kuolemme, jolloin laskemme irti tästä hetkestä ja vaihdamme sen ikuisuuteen, ja se hetki voi olla koska hyvänsä, minä tahansa hetkenä voit olla yksi näistä kuolleista etanoista, pienen kitiinikuoren alle arkkuun hadattuna. Niin se vain menee.

trackinfo.title: Light Infused In Darkness
trackinfo.lyrics: As my life descends to the light I realize we are all one
trackinfo.about:
Redemption through the wall of sounds.
My life is one with my death, I will give it away some day. This is the song for the end of all worlds, the end of all consciousnesses, the end of all life as it one day will come for every one of us. It gives our lives the meanings they have, so we should respect it as the driving force.

trackinfo.title: I Exit Life
trackinfo.lyrics: Stop your whining and stand up You lead your life to what it became The party's long gone Everyone else moved on But you hold on to the scraps! Self-destruction is your chosen path Lashing out to every offered hand You suffocate.. In your own deprivation Deliver yourself from desperation A Self-destroyed man A mouse bleeding out it's wrath Too weak minded to oppose the urge To go down the same old path. This fear binds my hands down And force-feeds me time Mankind standing idly beside me As I attempt suicide These arms are clean of wounds This soul is hacked to pieces This life of mine became the chain It keeps me tied to this pole It keeps me tied to this pole... It keeps me tied down... I exit life All god's unwanted children Join your hands with pride We're gonna die.
trackinfo.about:
About desperation and dedication, the understanding of the fact, that my life will end, and the decision that I will be the one to blow my own candle out. That is the true enlightenment, to end the cycle of any sort of rebirths or afterlives, to become complete in your own right, to disappear for good. Also a sing-along song for the doomsday cults.
"All god's unwanted children, join your hands with pride, we're gonna die."

trackinfo.title: Watch Them Bleed
trackinfo.lyrics: Drink from the veins of your king Abuse your daughters and stain them with sin Replace the thought with a grin Sow the seeds of guilt within Open your eyes and make their heads spin See the ice between you melt thin You are the king within the ring Entertain them with dead cow's skin Every time you lose, I win And every time you win, I quit The mountains watch me become a pig I punish myself with the stick I use my bones to break the stones and I consume the Holy Ghost I walk down the path you chose I write poems instead of prose The words pour down and start to corrode What I thought to be made of stone Sharing wine in the house of bones Feasting with the ones I oppose Letting the enemies come close All God's unwanted children Now join your hands with pride One thing they forgot to tell you Persistence pays off in time Just wait and watch them bleed Just wait and watch them bleed Just wait and watch them bleed to death

Junkyard Shaman.title: Like Rain
Junkyard Shaman.about:
I made this today, recorded mostly guitars and built everything collaging from the ground up, used different pieces from completely different times and places...
Today was a day of heavy rain. I walked four kilometres in it, completely soaked after the first 100 meters. Lately I have had a period of isolation with small, single glimpses of joy provided by beautiful human beings that appear to come and go through my life. I am grateful for every second of joy I get to live in this life. I love you all.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Lopun Ajan Kansan Lauluja
Junkyard Shaman.about:
My second cassette album. Experimental and psychedelic, droning pre-apocalyptic songs of the endtime folks.. Instruments played on this record: Acoustic and electric guitars, Ramses drug organ, clothes rack, salt shaker, empty paint drums, Kantele, comfy chairs and paintings (as a kick drums), piano, and probably something I forget. Knives and forks.
It's a sort of a loose theme album about a doomsday cult on a desert, losing their faith and getting filled with doubt and paranoia, but committing a mass suicide nevertheless.

trackinfo.title: Minä Olen Outo Piiri
trackinfo.lyrics: Olen elämä joka sykertyy itseensä sikiöasennossa vessan lattialla Olen likainen neula juna-aseman käytävällä olen ikuinen looppi joka aukeaa itseensä Olen tuhannet sirpaleet joista yksi aurinko tuijottaa tuhantena takaisin. Olen avoin käsi joka häviää nyrkkiin Olen palanut lamppu Olen sulake joka sen käräytti Olen saalis, olen metsästäjä, olen ase. Olen elementtitalo ja rotta joka sinne piiloutuu. Olen ensimmäinen, olen viimeinen. Olen siittiö ja olen tuhkaa. Olen ruostunut auto metsässä. Olen tragedia joka sen sinne ajoi. Olen unohdettu syyllisyys ja omaisten kärsimys Olen aurinko, olen ilo, olen suru. Olen olematon. Olen vankina maailmassa joka rusentuu kasaan Olen vankina tajunnassa joka rusentuu kasaan Olen olematon. Olen elossa, olen kuoleva, olen ruumis jossa on vielä valot päällä hetken aikaa. Vankina tajunnassa joka rusentuu kasaan, joka on vankina maailmassa joka rusentuu kasaan.

trackinfo.title: Lopun Ajan Kansan Laulu
trackinfo.lyrics: Heidän sormensa päistään lähteneet sähköiset rukoukset jäivät roikkumaan kuolleina ilmaan. Vastausta ei kuulunut, vain koirat haukkui, vaikka he olivat odottaneet jo kauan. Oliko jumala hyljännyt heidät tällaisella hetkellä, juuri nyt? Juuri maailmanlopun edessä? Lahkon johtaja levitteli käsiään ja toisti pyyntöään rukoushuoneen hiljaiselle katolle. Ilma oli sähköinen, bensa haisi, kaikki tuijottivat kattoa odottaen jumalan kaikkivoipaa kättä, joka koska tahansa nostaisi katon paikaltaan ja tempaisisi heidät kaikki ylös taivaaseen. Väkijoukossa kiersi jo myrkkymalja, josta jokainen vuorollaan joi. Lahkon johtaja näytti äkkiä niin pieneltä, niin hauraalta ja heikolta. Tämäkö oli se suuri ja karsimaattinen johtaja, jonka vuoksi he olivat jättäneet maaallisen elämän taakseen? Tämä oli se ihmeellinen parantaja, se suuri messias, jota he kaikki olivat seuranneet? Kynttilät valaisivat hiljaisuutta, paljastivat rivin toisensa jälkeen aavemaisia, kalpeita kasvoja. Aavemaisiksi ne teki ennen kaikkea se epävarmuus joka niiltä paistoi tämän uuden käänteen edessä. Jumala ei vastannutkaan heille. Jumala ei vastannutkaan heille, jumala ei vastaisikaan heille.. Hiljainen mutina alkoi kiertää väkijoukon seassa. Se ei silti estänyt jokaista vuorollaan juomasta maljasta lisää. Johtaja laski kätensä, kääntyi seurakuntansa puoleen ja alkoi laulaa hiljaa. Hän lauloi heidän virsiään, lopun ajan kansan lauluja, hän lauloi ja seurakunta yhtyi lauluun kunnes se yltyi huudoksi. Koko seurakunta oli nyt saanut myrkkynsä, hetki oli käsillä. Ensimmäiset alkoivat jo luhistua penkeillä. Pian jäljellä oli enää johtaja, joka sytytti verhot tuleen ja mutisi liekkien keskeltä: "VIELÄ TULEE AIKA, JOLLOIN JUMALAT KUISKIVAT PELOISSAAN JA KAIVATEN IHMISTEN NIMIÄ..."

Junkyard Shaman.title: Lost Mind
Junkyard Shaman.about:
The final part of a trilogy of albums that started with Flesh Hole and Dada Bones, Lost Mind is a collection of broken word poetry, scrap metal sounds, fragments of field recordings and gagaku instruments. The idea of these albums was to simulate my consciousness collaged as sound, with ill remembered memories mixing up with vanishing dreams and subconscious hallucinations. On this last one I also wanted to bring in the approach of breaking down the architecture of language and therefore the consciousness and mind itself.
Tape released by the suberb Sata Tuhatta Tapes, order tapes through them;
satatuhatta.bandcamp.com/album/lost-mind
Thank you!

Junkyard Shaman.title: Love is a Prison
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Born out of sheer frustration, I dug into my old tape loops and recordings and cut and past this late at night 12th of May, 2021. It consists of live recordings made in Osaka, Japan and Pori, Finland.
I wanted to make an ocean of silence, nothing happening again and again, transmitting emotion through sound without "music". All titles were created by artificial intelligence.

trackinfo.title: Mudpeople
trackinfo.lyrics: I raised my hands in a prayer towards the skies There was no answer, just the same old dull grayness Endless skies above me, skies that looked exactly like the earth around me. It was all alike, all the same, all exactly the same. No difference whatsoever. Everywhere I went, everywhere I turned my head it was all the same, color of the burnt dirt Color of my father's eyes, the deep gray all over. I thought this would purify me, I thought this would cleanse me, I thought this would save me. But I should already know there is no such thing as redemption. We are all cursed, all abandoned, all alike. All burnt dirt. Just waiting to be wiped away. Do I sound depressing? I apologize, for that is not my intention. My intention is solely to amuse, but as you probably noticed, my sense of humour is kinda bleak. I've seen too many politicians spewing filth upon good people, I've seen too many priests abusing the trust of the innocent, I've seen far too many mothers killing their children to believe in good. I've seen the fathers break their son's legs and tell them to run. I've heard the snap of the bone, seen a limb give up under pressure. I wipe the spit off my lips. I need to calm down, I know, I know.  This city is a dead rat, an empty bomb shell, a forgotten grave on the side of the road. It's full of dead people who just weren't told they were supposed to die a long time ago.  They think it all will turn out good in the end.  But there will be no end. They will never see such thing. There is none. ---- My eyes are filled with doubt My skull is full of mud I try to open my dry mouth but I find it's sewn shut I hope to find a way to understand my own position and to ease this fix by approximation But I find it's not my decision. I can't be held responsible for all the mumble I release It's always just an attempt to find a temporary ease So please, if you do mind anything I say Just strangle me with piano-wire and make me go away. For I am not here to irritate I am not here to amuse either. I am here to prove a point and to  burn alive in front of your eyes. I am here to burn I am here to burn I am here to burn alive Until I'm nothing but dust.
trackinfo.credits: from Mudpeople, released November 6, 2014

trackinfo.title: Crushing Insects pt. 3
trackinfo.lyrics: The mouldy floorboards were covered with cockroaches. Someone had knocked a half-empty bag of crisps off the counter and the vermin were enjoying their feast, salt & vinegar remains of someones breakfast or lunch or whatever. The flat was cold, the heating had gone off long ago. At the far end corner, on a rugged mattress there was a  shivering, tired ruin of a young man crying. He did not mind the insects, that were crawling on his floor, he did not mind the cold, he did not mind the fact his life had had no meaning in a long while, he did not even mind the fact that he might be about to die. Actually, that was the only portion of his life he seemed to wait anxiously. Death seemed like an first price on the sucking competition he called his life. It seemed like every single decision, usually a bad one, was leading towards this final culmination point: dying in a rented apartment at some suburbia, with his veins so empty of drugs he could feel the cold in his bones. Not on his skin, though. It seemed like his skin would be on fire, stung with thousands of tiny needles, like all the cockraches would be right there under his skin, like all the knives in the world would be stored inside his body. He felt kinda bad, but he could remember one morning worse than this. Although it seemed distant now, when he was wallowing in his current ocean of disgust and pain. It was rare that he could actually remember feeling worse in this sort of state, but you can understand it feels like the worst hangover ever, when you wake up without three of your toes and out of money, food or drugs. Young man turned around on his side, watched the cockroaches devour his crisps, but didn't know what to think of it. It had been his last money, but it was yesterday. This was a new day. A new beginning. A new hell.  He tried to get up, but he couldn't. His body was too weak and the pain was overwhelming. He made a noise of some sort, it was a long, moany groan, and the cockroaches fleed. They had learned to avoid his wrath, his leather boots made messy remarks of too slow insects on the floor. "Note to the rest: Run faster." He was sure he would die, he would freeze and starve to death.  But eventually the knives under his skin smoothened their edges,  sharp pain became blunt pain and his eyes adjusted to the painful light. He gathered his strength and rose to his feet, like the first mammal ever to attempt walking on two feet, out of balance, disoriented. He took slow, careful steps and crushed the crisps on the floor. He got out of the door, in to the small corridor, went to the first floor and out of the door. He went outside, and saw a homeless guy on a dirty street. There was graffiti on the nearby wall and the wind was restlessly kicking around yesterday's newspaper. He passed the homeless person who was left staring at his back, he passed the graffiti, he passed the newspaper, he crossed the street and went to a nearby shop. He stole a Kitkat and ate it as soon as he got out.  It tasted better than anything he had ever eaten before. He looked down at his shoes. They were almost worn out,  they wouldn't crush insects for long. He sighed. His life was way too hard to be dealt with right now. He wanted nothing more than a fix. A justification for his guilt, anything at all. He felt sick, he felt like he could not live with his self.  He could not live without a fix and couldn't live if he got one. He'd probably just overdose and get it over with. Life, when did you become so intolerable, he thought to himself as he crawled back into his hell.
trackinfo.credits: from Mudpeople, released November 6, 2014

Junkyard Shaman.title: Music for the Observation Tree
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This is a sound installation I created with Terhi Eskelinen to accompany Henri Ijäs' conceptual art installation "Observation Tree" which inspired the whole soundscape right then and there. The piece was formerly owned by Aapo Korkeaoja, and it observed the ownership of art. Tree itself is picked up from the ground and the roots are put on display at Korkeaoja, in conceptual art exhibition Käsitekesä 2018. It is possible to visit the exhibition until August 2018. Google provides you with further information.
With this sound installation I think I managed to bring another aspect to this piece, turning the focus from ownership to the questions of power and powerlessness, nature did all the work growing the tree while human beings claim ownership over it, while it itself is left without a voice. All in all standing there, sheltered from the rain, observing the tree under one spotlight with this soundscape was a very immersive and meditative experience. So this is a conceptual collaboration of many different aspects, sound being only one of them.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Outo Piiri II
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Everything hashed, cut, recycled and recomposed from loops, field recordings and other junk. This is a dadaist sound collage/installation of my brain.
Few years back I made this Outo Piiri I tape, which was made from instrument tracks of different songs, spoken word poetry and field recordings, this is pretty much the follow up for that.These are also tape loops I have used while playing live. I would upload first one too, but I haven't had it since I sold them out pretty much instantly. There is a limited tape edition of this, this is of course best experienced from an old, recycled tape. None of this music has existed in this form before, but some of the material might be familiar from the past.
This album is also a conceptual soundtrack for my new poetry book Metadada, which is available (ONLY IN FINNISH) 20th of October, 2018.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Resonations in B
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This album is meant to be played simultaneously with Hesitations in B. I recommend you download them both (after all they are free) and play them in separate players, burn them on CD or whatever. This one is more based on drones, spoken words and distortion.
1.Human Problems
2. Electric Smoke
3. Acid Christ

trackinfo.title: Resonations in B
trackinfo.lyrics: Human Problems ------- Mortal enemies like cancer or rotten teeth. stepping on a toy in pitch black darkness. the will to quit your job but not having the guts to do so. the existential dread that lives inside every living cell but blooms at different stages of life in different bodies. the need to eat. the need to shit. the need to sleep. the instinct of survival no matter how much you hurt your loved ones. the habit of calling something distinctively humane "inhumane". the fear of death. the fear of heights. not being able to shit or piss on command. the thought of having to bury both of your parents before someone else gets to bury you. taxes. voting. society. being illogical. hope. stress, distress and happiness. late night glooms. the inevitability of waking up one morning and not having milk for your coffee. childhood traumas. not being able to prevent from inflicting traumas on your offspring. trying to forget all of these when you finally get to be happy for a moment... Electric Smoke ------ Fingers arched, backbone limp, tired of excuses.. I hurt myself as I crawled out of my body a while ago all the knives that are glued to my soul scratch my bones as I crawl out of myself, shrug dead skin cells off my shoulders and expose my flesh to direct sunlight it sears my flesh and dries it up like clay.. my movements slow down as my body freezes completely, my mind still way too active and alive inside its trap. Every move is another proof that I should not move at all, to stop completely, to end my urges and impulses now.  I hope there will be some sort of final solution, endgame, something to gain out of this experience, this final battle of hurling ricochet bullets and electric smoke... Acid Christ ----- I went to the deep end just for the sake of argument and what I saw was nothing profound at all. Acid christ, solvent savior, light-headed God, stupid little insect. Enlightenment does not come easy Wisdom can't be stolen Sit down, stare inside and shut the fuck up. Your mind is a trap you built for yourself, so delicately placed all the trapdoors, placed the hidden mines, wrapped broken glass and barbwire around your soul. Now sit back and watch it all unfold.  Acid christ, solvent savior, the Weight and the Door. Cheap Jesus, second cum dripping wasted on the floor.
trackinfo.credits: from Resonations in B, released September 16, 2016

Junkyard Shaman.title: Ruostuva Maailma / Palava Mieli
Junkyard Shaman.about: My new full length album, available as a digipack CD. It deals with the consciousness and death, childhood and growing up, slow burning process, rusting of the world and the mind. Psychological self portrait, in a way.
Junkyard Shaman.credits:
released April 14, 2017
Jere Kilpinen - guitars (12 string, acoustics and electrics, with and without bow), salt shakers, empty paint drums, kantele, accordion, scrap metal bowls, clothes drying rack, my body, ukulele, drug organs, wurlitzer 200 A, diy springstruments, forks and knives, junk in general. Also mixing, mastering, artwork, and everything else. I could have saved few seconds by saying "everything", but I wanted to give you an idea of the instrumentation on this album. Now I've wasted even more of your time, but in a way it is your own fault since you're the one that made the decision to continue reading.

Junkyard Shaman.title: Seasons in the Sky
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This is my 5 seasons.
It might sound different if I would have been priviledged enough to have an access to a classical orchestra or even a group of friends and enough time to work in peace, but that is not my reality, so as always, I worked on it alone and without "proper" equipment. I think in the end it made it better. My life is a life of natural flow and rhythm.
It is also a life of liminality and changes. In my mind there are two worlds. That of Japan, which has the natural, cyclic sense of year, where at every season something beautiful blooms and comes to life, but also perpetually dies in order to give birth to something beautiful and new. The other one is the nature of Finland which still lingers on in my memories, that in which the life is short and death is long, spring and summer are brief sparks of life that slowly decay into darkness and cold, silent seasons of death. But within that death, there is also beauty and life. The gravity of a silent snowflake as it falls down in the dark night, the patience of the pine trees as they wait for the spring sun to make the snow heavy enough to melt and let it fall off to the ground...the perpetually repeating cycles of life.
Rebirth.
Something my body and mind also go through each year. The rhythm and flow of nature. The big, beautiful loop that has always been the base of my expression.
I use loops, because they are the most natural thing, repeating, but never remaining exactly the same, spiralling out, changing unnoticeably, until they become something completely different altogether... that is the natural rhythm and flow of my music.

trackinfo.title: Still Frame
trackinfo.lyrics: As the summer sun was about to set We were sitting in the park, at the city hall, remembering the old days, that in fact weren't too far in the past. Now that day is further in the past, than those "good old days" were back then. Everything was illuminated by the rusty light and the pines were bleeding and glowing. We talked about how precious this moment was this short-lived still frame in time. How we were forever stuck there in that tiny fragment and how everything was good just the way it was. It was still warm, for it had been great day. It was one of the best evenings in my life especially because there was nothing special to it. It was just another evening with just another sunset with a friend. We talked about that evening, how acknowlidging it made it even more special and how words or songs  could never do it any justice no matter how we tried. And now it's in the past put behind us. And I sometimes wonder if you still remember that evening the way I do As one of the best evenings in my life.
trackinfo.credits: from Simple Songs From The Mouth Of A Dog, released February 16, 2015

trackinfo.title: Insomnia
trackinfo.lyrics: Sunset was dripping down my jaw,  trying to sneak out of the world to leave it in the absent twilight As if anyone wouldn't notice I saw a mother breastfeed a grown dog in the alley things always turn strange after the sun turns his watching eye away And the dogs start to sing and the lizards howl with their electric tongues and the gypsies gather around the fountains trying to sell drugs to kids and kids trying to buy drugs from anyone but the gypsies. Cold chill goes down your spine  and up your ass Life goes on after you're gone You watch these chameleons assume a pose camouflage, to dissolve into their surroundings to avoid being noticed. Massive concrete buildings, element rattraps all basking in the darkness gleaming in their own right, concealing hundreds of pasts thousands of futures within their walls after a night of raced heartbeats they always seem so huge And you always feel so small Until the sun comes back if it comes back Here it never comes back. The shadows in your soul are so deep no light can penetrate them or make them go away You are left breathless in a ditch of your own thoughts Lost without landmarks lost without maps lost without gods Your hands are shaking from all the caffeine and your mind feels like it's wrapped in furs and soaked in blood. It doesn't make things any easier. These dark intentions everyone keeps carrying around like they were their babies, their only true treasure You're not alone We are all here, at the bottom of a sea that's dried out We're all thirsty We're all hungry hungry for answers, for gods for some spiritual healing clawing each others eyes and gnawing each others bones we're all here lost without maps lost without gods.
trackinfo.credits: from Simple Songs From The Mouth Of A Dog, released February 16, 2015

Junkyard Shaman.title: Songs for the Old Chestnut Tree
Junkyard Shaman.about: Instrumental music, meditative, transcendenting. Practically three same songs in completely different output. Probably one reason I enjoy making instrumental music so much is the fact I like reading a lot, and it's great to have instrumental music, that carries emotions, colors your thoughts without interfering you consciousness directly. It speaks to your subconscious and surpasses you. You might not remember a thing about the songs, but you end up feeling something, and from my point of view that is one of the main goals of my music. These are mostly inspired by the works of Hermann Hesse.

trackinfo.title: Like Moths to the Flame
trackinfo.about: And Goldmund realised how all beauty in life dwells in it's short and vain course towards extinction, how all life tries to evade the imminence of it's end by drowning into vanity of everyday life. How we are like moths to the flame, like silver-sided fish, grasping for air, and death is the merchant, selling our life for anyone who is willing to pay.
trackinfo.credits: from Songs for the Old Chestnut Tree, released October 1, 2012

trackinfo.title: The House of the Dead
trackinfo.about: Goldmund entered the seemingly abandoned house, which turned out to be the house of the dead. Whole family, killed by plague, black and swollen, in the state of decomposing. Goldmund observed their expressions, how they had faced death, some calm, some with fear. He saw his own face decaying, he saw his own bones wither and die, and he stood peacefully in the face of this dreadful sight.
trackinfo.credits: from Songs for the Old Chestnut Tree, released October 1, 2012

trackinfo.title: Life of a Vagrant
trackinfo.about: A long path out of your own destiny.
trackinfo.credits: from Songs for the Old Chestnut Tree, released October 1, 2012

trackinfo.title: Out of Luck
trackinfo.about: Sometimes it's sunshine, sometimes it's rain, sometimes it's love, sometimes it's pain, they're all just single threads that entangle and entwine to weave this wall cloth that is our lives.
trackinfo.credits: from Songs for the Old Chestnut Tree, released October 1, 2012

trackinfo.title: The Old Chestnut Tree
trackinfo.about: And Goldmund returned to the monastery, returned home to die. And Narcissus sat by his side, and Goldmund told him death did not frighten him, it seemed like returning to his mother, who'd take him back to innocence of non-existence. How could one die without a mother, how could man love without a mother? The old chestnut tree stood outside, majestic, eternal compared to the short lives of men.
trackinfo.credits: from Songs for the Old Chestnut Tree, released October 1, 2012

Junkyard Shaman.title: Standing at the End of Time...
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Through a dream I heard the sound of the waves
crashing into my shores
bringing wreckage of my memories
or what was left of them
Magnetic dreams were repeating on a loop
and my mind was occupied by electric visions
of horrors unimaginable...
And the days went by
and I sat still.
Until the silent, falling snow
made everything disappear
and I was standing there
at the end of time
looking into to past crumbling in the distance
Thousand buddhas
whisper empty promises of disappearing
yet I am here once again
for a 10 000th time
watching it all unfold
once again...

Junkyard Shaman.title: Studies on Silence
Junkyard Shaman.about:
This album was recorded in February 2020. It is an exploration into the nature of expressing silence with a distinct sound, trying to achieve the sensation of silence through sound. Experimenting with different compositional and instrumental choices in order to make time float. To achieve indifference, the sense of meaninglessness that sitting in silence produces.
These pieces include experiments with acoustic guitar, shakuhachi, tape loops, drones and mental landscapes.

Junkyard Shaman.title: The Best at Murder Are Those Who Preach Against It
Junkyard Shaman.about:
Recorded live at Environment 0g, 7th of March 2021. I was tempted to name this Gutaigagaku (具体雅楽) since to me this sounds like what gagaku might sound like if it was filtered through gutai spirit, using everyday junk instruments.
Gagaku is the traditional court music of Japan, that came through China. It relies on long suspended drones and repetition, and I first heard it as a child from a CD-ROM dictionary we had with our very early PC. It blew me away instantly. I knew THIS was music. Real music. Nothing like I had ever heard before. REAL MUSIC, nature of sound itself, breaths, hearts, blood circulation, spirit unfolding, memory, consciousness. Real music. It changed the way I perceived music and certainly played a huge influence on how I started making music. I didn't care for chords or structures or melodies, I just rather play one wave of sound until it makes me see things. And little by little it has evolved, through years of practice, with every iteration, into something like this.
Gutai is a post-war avantgarde movement that started here in Osaka with Jiro Yoshihara in 1950's and ended with his death in 1972, after which many of the remaining artist spread the Gutai spirit on to new generation of artists. I have had the honor to get to know these artists and participate in the performances and see the exhibitions, and it has had an huge impact on my art too. It had made me feel like I have found a home, something that comes to me naturally and makes my brain light up like fireworks while thinking of work. What always annoyed my with Fluxus for example, was the same thing that annoyed Duchamp, they just took what Dada did, and over rationalized it and forced it into words. Killed it. In Gutai, words are unnecessary. It is something more profound, as the name dubs it, "concrete". You feel it in your gut.
Junkyard Shaman.credits:
released April 2, 2021
Jere Kilpinen - Junk metal percussion, saxophone, guitar, loops,

Junkyard Shaman.title: The Hermit And The Sea
Junkyard Shaman.about:
The Hermit and the Sea, recorded in Osaka and Busan, marks a shift from Junkyard Shaman’s spoken word collages to a textless, sea-centered sound work. This cassette-only release is built from coastal field recordings, and it's a piece designed to decay, fully revealing itself only as the tape wears down and the sounds merge into an indistinct, eroded mass.
NOTE: This work is not digital and does not include download. It is only on tape, limited to 120 copies, released by Satatuhatta, 2025.
